```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("data/visits.csv")
churches = pd.read_csv("data/churches.csv")

top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
n_free = int(attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free").sum())
```

# Attractions

## Row {height=20%}

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Most visited attraction, 2025"
dict(icon="trophy", color="primary", value=top["attraction"])
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total visits 2025, top ten ALVA member attractions"
dict(icon="people", color="info", value=f"{attractions['visits_2025'].sum():,}")
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Free general admission (of the top ten)"
dict(icon="ticket", color="success", value=f"{n_free} of {len(attractions)}")
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{python}
#| title: "Visits in 2025 by attraction (ALVA member attractions)"
fig = px.bar(attractions.sort_values("visits_2025"), x="visits_2025", y="attraction",
             orientation="h", labels={"visits_2025": "Visits in 2025", "attraction": ""},
             color_discrete_sequence=["#1f6f8b"])
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Visits by year, 2015–2025 (2020–2021 pandemic years; NHM includes gardens from 2024)"
fig = px.line(visits, x="year", y="visits", color="attraction", markers=True,
              labels={"visits": "Visits", "year": "Year", "attraction": ""})
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
                  legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.2, entrywidth=170))
fig
```

::: {.card title="Source"}
ALVA, *Visits made in 2015–2025 to visitor attractions in membership with ALVA*
([2025 table](https://www.alva.org.uk/details.cfm?p=423)), retrieved 2026-10-30. ALVA counts
only its member sites.
:::

# Churches

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Cathedrals and churches on Visit London's list"
from IPython.display import Markdown

rows = "\n".join(f"| [{r.church}]({r.visit_london}) | {r.type} |" for r in churches.itertuples())
Markdown("| Church | Type |\n|---|---|\n" + rows)
```

::: {.card title="Source"}
Visit London, [*Cathedrals and churches in London*](https://www.visitlondon.com/things-to-do/sightseeing/london-attraction/historic/cathedrals-and-churches-in-london),
retrieved 2026-10-31: Visit London's editorial list, in page order, not a ranking.
:::
